planting_details.assumptions_or_notes: Assumed rainfed smallholder conditions in Trans-Nzoia highlands with a single main long-rains maize season. H614 is a highland hybrid; typical extension guidance uses ~75 cm row spacing and ~25 cm in-row spacing, giving ~5.3 plants/m² final stand. PDATE chosen as median of the common planting window after onset of long rains. Row direction set to 0 (N–S) by default; actual fields may follow contours. Values represent typical practice rather than research-station optima.

events.Assumptions_or_Notes: Basal DAP (diammonium phosphate) 18-46-0 placed as a band/spot near the seed at planting, ~5 cm to the side and below the seed row; typical of smallholders in Trans Nzoia. Implied product rate: 75 kg/ha, giving 13.5 kg N/ha and 15.1 kg P/ha (P calculated as P2O5×0.4364; 0.46×0.4364=0.200744; 75×0.200744≈15.1). No K commonly applied at planting in this system.

Topdress urea 46-0-0 broadcast around plants during first weeding (~30 DAP), left on the surface to be washed in by rainfall; a common practice (some farmers alternatively use CAN). Implied product rate: 166.3 kg/ha (76.5/0.46), supplying 76.5 kg N/ha; no P or K supplied. Total N across events is exactly 90.0 kg N/ha (13.5 basal + 76.5 topdress).
